repository.chronology_note: The initial implementation predates the post by 35 seconds. Later commits add prompt studies and progress-bar changes; these additions must not be retrospectively attributed to the original tweet experiment.

pointwise.score_prompt: How relevant is the passage to the query?
pointwise.score_rubric: TREC DL four ordered relevance descriptions; exact strings at the linked source, lines 59-65.
pointwise.ranking_signal: P(yes) or expected relevance level; stable descending sort
pointwise.calls: One request per passage, 100 per query with top-100 inputs

pairwise.prompt: Which of the two passages is more relevant to the query?
pairwise.aggregation: Evaluate both passage orders; A wins if (P(A in original order) + 1 - P(A in reversed order)) / 2 >= 0.5.

setwise.prompt: Which passage is the most relevant one to the query?
setwise.ranking_algorithm: Heap sort with 10 children plus their parent, at most 11 candidates per local comparison; top k=10.

listwise.choice_mode: One most_relevant Choice over the window; sort all passages by returned probability, preserving original index on ties.
listwise.score_mode: One Score per passage, all questions in the same request; sort by expected relevance level, preserving original index on ties.
listwise.score_prompt_template: How relevant is passage {label} to the query?
listwise.direction: Bottom-to-top sliding window; 100/100 evaluates all candidates in one request.

published_experiment_configuration.tokenizer: tiktoken cl100k_base, explicitly approximate because Jev tokenizer is not public
published_experiment_configuration.provider_note: The source normalizes Vercel boolean/probability to the TypeSafe noul schema. This is a different endpoint and concurrency regime from Open-Jev current direct TypeSafe API timing.

metric_and_cost_contract.primary_metric: nDCG@10 with graded qrels; all qrel query IDs in the denominator, missing run query contributes zero (trec_eval -c semantics).
metric_and_cost_contract.table_api_latency: Mean successful HTTP round-trip time per request, weighted by successful calls across DL19+DL20, not total reranking time per query.
metric_and_cost_contract.latency_timing_boundary: requests.Session.post only; request throttling precedes timer; retry sleep and unsuccessful attempts are not in the retained successful latency list. The shared Session may reuse connections.
metric_and_cost_contract.cost_per_query_formula: Total successful-response input tokens / 1e6 * 0.042, summed across DL19+DL20 and divided by total queries. This is an estimate, not an invoice.
metric_and_cost_contract.baselines: README explicitly says monoBERT/RankGPT/RankZephyr numbers are copied from papers, not rerun by this Jev experiment.
metric_and_cost_contract.zero_shot_claim: The original README describes one run per method and no prompt tuning; later commits add prompt studies and rerun variability analysis.

not_independently_verified: No TREC corpus, candidate passage file, queries or qrels were downloaded, so BM25 ordering and nDCG values were not recomputed.
No author per-request raw responses, run files or stats JSON were found in the reviewed Git tree; jev/runs/ is git-ignored. Published aggregate results remain author-reported.
The code uses mutable provider model aliases and unpinned package requirements; exact backend weights and original installed versions cannot be reconstructed from this source alone.
prepare_data.sh uses Hugging Face resolve/main with no file digest, so exact original first-stage data revision is not pinned.
No invoice or failed-attempt billing record is supplied; total billed cost, including any charged retries, is unknown.
The chronological nearby initial code commit is relevant evidence but does not prove that every tweet run executed that exact commit.
